name: Glory Forever Public Company Limited
summary: Glory Forever Public Company Limited primarily operates as a digital publishing company. It manages Kawebook.com, an entertainment-focused e-commerce hub designed to connect online readers, writers, and content publishers. Additionally, the firm oversees JINOVEL, a specialized platform for digital reading and creative writing. Beyond its core publishing ventures, Glory Forever diversifies its services to include cybersecurity solutions, the distribution of healthcare products, and offerings tailored for virtual influencers. The company was established in 2017 and is based in Mueang Samut Sakhon, Thailand.
